name: molworld4d-bench
description: Auditable evaluation workflows for generated protein-ligand molecular dynamics trajectories.

interface.longDescription: Choose an auditable physical-time evaluation profile, validate trajectory protocols, run ComplexMD-Eval, and interpret structural, ensemble, kinetic, interaction, uncertainty, and efficiency results without overstating non-estimable metrics.
defaultPrompt: Evaluate my generated protein-ligand trajectories against reference MD.
Choose a defensible MolWorld4D-Bench profile for this protocol.
Audit these ComplexMD-Eval results for scientific comparability.
